meta.title: A Different Road to the Coast

paragraphs: On Sunday morning, Dad read the newspaper at breakfast. "There is a fun run in town today," he said. "But we can still go to the coast." Mom put extra water and extra sandwiches in a big bag. Tom and Lily took towels, and Pip jumped into the car. The family left at half past nine.

First, Dad drove along the usual road to the coast. The traffic was quiet, and the day was sunny. Then they came to a corner, and a police officer stood in the road. He held up his hand. "Sorry, this road is closed for the race," he said. "It will open at eleven o'clock." "Is there another way to the coast?" asked Dad. "Yes, but it is one hour longer," said the police officer. "Let's wait and watch the race," said Mom. "A short delay is fine," said Dad. Dad stopped the car and turned off the engine.

The family got out and stood next to the road. Soon, they heard people clapping. A girl in a yellow T-shirt ran past very fast. "She is the winner!" shouted Tom. After her, many other runners came. Some of them were young, and some of them were old. Lily clapped for every runner, and Pip said, "Woof!" At half past ten, the last runner passed.

But the police officer did not open the road. "Workers must clean the road, and it will take one more hour," he said. "Do you want to wait?" asked Dad. "No, let's go," said Tom. "We can see more of the coast if we go now," said Lily. The police officer pointed to the left. "Turn left at the market, and then go along the river," he said. Dad thanked him and drove away. After that, the road was longer, but it was beautiful. There were green fields and small houses along the river. Lily took photos from the window.

Finally, the family arrived at the coast at noon. The beach was quiet, and the water was blue. They sat under a tree and ate the extra sandwiches. Afterwards, Tom and Lily walked on the sand with Pip. In the evening, Lily wrote the day in her diary in order. It was not our usual day, but it was a good one.
text.summary: The family drives to the coast on Sunday. A fun run closes the usual road, so they wait, watch the runners, and take a different road.
